semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides aftermarket parts and services for the semiconductor industry, focusing on manufacturing components and repair services.
summary: Advanced Materials Technology & Engineering, Inc. specializes in manufacturing aftermarket parts and providing repair services for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries. Their offerings include ceramic, quartz, and engineering thermoplastic parts, as well as repair services for various semiconductor equipment.
capabilities: Manufacturing of ceramic and quartz parts for semiconductor equipment
Repair services for valves, robots, and RF generators
Sales of flow monitoring and control products
technical_expertise: Repair and maintenance of semiconductor equipment
